attack_mechanism: Software can move R4-derived operands through the peripheral decode path during an SFR, watchdog, interrupt, or multiplier access. `openMSP430.frontend_0.irq_all` retains a decoded value or selected peripheral result on that path; the state and data choices on this path depend on `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.src_reg_src_sel`, `openMSP430.mem_backbone_0.ext_per_en`, `openMSP430.sfr_0.ie1_wr`. Observing `openMSP430.frontend_0.irq_all` while a chosen peripheral transaction consumes R4 exposes a value correlated with the register contents. The implementation carries the effect through `openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.r4 -> openMSP430.execution_unit_0.register_file_0.reg_src -> openMSP430.mem_backbone_0.eu_per_sel -> openMSP430.watchdog_0.wdt_irq -> openMSP430.frontend_0.irq_all`. Across selected operands or repeated transactions, that correlation discloses R4 bits outside the protected register file.
